basic_details.job_title: NAM Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Yoga Instructor, Physiotherapist Posts
basic_details.short_information: The District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU) of the National AYUSH Mission, Malappuram is hiring a Yoga Instructor (Rs. 14,000 a month) and a Physiotherapist (Rs. 21,000 a month) on contract basis for various AYUSH institutions in Malappuram District. The vacancies are anticipatory. Applications are submitted online at careers.nam.kerala.gov.in, and the last date is 6 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Check that you meet the qualification and age limit for the post you are applying for.
Submit the application form online at the National AYUSH Mission Kerala careers portal (careers.nam.kerala.gov.in).
Fill in all details clearly in the application. The notice says incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Make sure the particulars you enter match your original documents. These documents must be produced at the time of the Interview.
Submit the online application on or before 6 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The District Programme Management & Supporting Unit (DPMSU) is the district office of the National AYUSH Mission in Malappuram, Kerala. Through this career notification, the unit is filling posts on contract basis under various AYUSH institutions in Malappuram District. The notice is signed by the District Programme Manager, National AYUSH Mission, Malappuram, and the office can be reached on phone 0483-2731700 or at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts. It does not print a number of vacancies for either post. Instead, it describes both as "Anticipatory".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate for the Yoga Instructor post needs any one of the following qualifications: BNYS (Bachelor of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences) BAMS MSc (Yoga) MPhil (Yoga) Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (minimum one year duration) from a recognized University Approved Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) from a recognized University or Government Department YCB (Yoga Certification Board) Certificate Yoga Teacher Training Course of at least one year's duration from the State Resource Centre (SRC) Diploma in Yogic Science & Sports Yoga conducted by SCOLE Kerala Certificate Course in Yoga (one year duration) The age limit for the Yoga Instructor post is "Not exceeding 50 Years" as on 21 November 2026. Only a person born on or after 21 November 1976 can apply. A candidate for the Physiotherapist post needs a Graduation/Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by a recognized University. The age limit is "not exceed 40 years" as on 21 November 2026. The notice does not mention any experience requirement or age relaxation for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each post.

rows.essential_qualification: One of the yoga or AYUSH qualifications listed below
rows.age_limit_as_on_21_11_2026: Not exceeding 50 years (born on or after 21-11-1976)

rows.essential_qualification: Graduation/Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by recognized University

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are filled on contract basis. The notice calls the pay a "Monthly Consolidated Remuneration": 14000/- for the Yoga Instructor and 21,000/- for the Physiotherapist. The notice does not mention any allowances or the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet the qualification and age limit for the post you are applying for. Submit the application form online at the National AYUSH Mission Kerala careers portal (careers.nam.kerala.gov.in). Fill in all details clearly in the application. The notice says incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Make sure the particulars you enter match your original documents. These documents must be produced at the time of the Interview. Submit the online application on or before 6 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the selection procedure includes a Skill Test/Written Test and an Interview, "as the case may be". At the Interview, candidates must produce their original documents. If the particulars in the application form do not tally with those documents, the candidature will be rejected. The notice does not give dates for the test or the Interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice does not print a number of vacancies. Both the Yoga Instructor and Physiotherapist posts are listed as "Anticipatory".

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: Candidates need one of the listed qualifications. These include BNYS, BAMS, MSc (Yoga), MPhil (Yoga), a one-year PG Diploma in Yoga, a YCB certificate, a one-year SRC Yoga Teacher Training Course, the SCOLE Kerala Diploma in Yogic Science & Sports Yoga, or a one-year Certificate Course in Yoga.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Physiotherapist post?
faq.answer: The Physiotherapist post requires a Graduation/Post Graduation in Physiotherapy approved by a recognized University.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For the Yoga Instructor post, the age must not exceed 50 years (born on or after 21 November 1976). For the Physiotherapist post, the age must not exceed 40 years. Both limits are counted as on 21 November 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Yoga Instructor and a Physiotherapist at NAM Malappuram?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated remuneration is Rs. 14,000 for the Yoga Instructor and Rs. 21,000 for the Physiotherapist.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit the application form online at careers.nam.kerala.gov.in by 6 December 2026. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NAM Malappuram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection procedure includes a Skill Test/Written Test and an Interview, as the case may be.

faq.question: Q9. Are the NAM Malappuram posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. The Yoga Instructor and Physiotherapist posts are filled on contract basis for AYUSH institutions in Malappuram District.
